newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen North Jianshe 96 net down 82 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen North Jianshe 96 net down 82 pct.

text.p: Year ended December 31, 1996 (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures) Turnover 2,491.75 vs 3,614.67
Earnings per share 0.11 yuan vs 0.60 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen North Jianshe Motorcycle Co Ltd.
Note: The results, compiled using international accounting standards, were published in the company's annual report released by a company official on Tuesday.
The company's board of directors have proposed a cash dividend of 0.069 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 30, the company official said.
Trading in the firm's B shares was suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, according to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
